mentions.name: AS Notes
mentions.description: A VS Code extension that brings Logseq/Obsidian-style personal knowledge management into the editor. It implements [[wikilinking]] with autocomplete and automatic page creation, a backlinks panel, page aliases via YAML front matter, a templated daily journal, and task management built on markdown checkboxes with a workspace-wide Tasks panel. Notes stay as plain local .md files under Git version control, indexed by a WASM-powered local SQLite database, with no cloud sync, telemetry, or accounts.
mentions.problem: People who live in VS Code have to manage their notes in separate apps, dealing with Electron wrappers, separate tools, and syncing headaches.
mentions.audience: People who already work in VS Code and want to keep personal notes and knowledge management in their existing editor.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A PKMS (Personal Knowledge Management System) VS Code extension - "AS Notes"

https://www.appsoftware.com/products/knowledge-management/as-notes

It implements [[wikilinking]], backlinking, task management into VS Code. The idea is to bring Logseq / Obsidian capability to VS Code.
